title: RewardResult
description: The MEASUREMENT produced by applying a RewardSpec to one environment run. EVIDENCE only: is_truth is always false and a reward result is never a promotion authority by itself — it is a number plus a per-check breakdown, scored deterministically against a declared ruler. passed is a convenience verdict (typically score == max_score, or a spec-defined threshold). The breakdown[] preserves per-check lineage so a winner always has lineage to the losing checks.

reward_spec_id.description: the RewardSpec used to score (the ruler)

run_id.description: the environment run that was scored

max_score.description: the achievable total, echoed from the RewardSpec

passed.description: convenience verdict for whether the run met the spec's threshold

breakdown.description: per-check results {check_id, points, max_points, passed, detail} — lineage from the total to each scoring unit

is_truth.description: ALWAYS false — a reward result is evidence/measurement, never served truth, and never a promotion authority on its own
